name: Elderfield Co-op
author: Elderfield Co-op
description: Co-op for up to 4 players. CO-OP on the title screen makes a co-op copy of your game the first time (its own folder and its own saves; this game and its saves are not changed), keeps it up to date after game updates, and starts it. Mods > Elderfield Co-op: whether co-op connects through Steam or directly.
